arrival.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
arrival.text: Welcome to Mars, Jin. It is sol eleven. First, dock with Asteria station. Our surface crew needs a reliable relay before a dust storm reaches Meridian. Restore the link, secure your field kit, and prepare the lander. Tomorrow, you will help protect the outpost. Once the storm passes, a rover survey awaits.

docked.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
docked.text: Docking capture confirmed. Welcome aboard Asteria. Move through the station to the briefing console. Take your time, and check each system before you change it.

brief.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
brief.text: The surface relay has lost its pointing solution. Review the fault report, identify the antenna branch, and isolate that circuit before the repair. Keep habitat power and life support online. Then realign the antenna and verify the link.

relay.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
relay.text: The relay test is complete. Meridian has a stable local link again. Messages to Earth still take time to travel. Collect your field kit, then complete the transfer pressure check before boarding the lander.

lander.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
lander.text: You are aboard the lander. Confirm the guidance solution and inspect propulsion readiness. Both checks must be complete before you commit to descent. Your destination is Meridian outpost.

descent.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
descent.text: Descent authorized. Meridian is waiting below. Guidance is tracking the landing corridor. Stay with the vehicle through entry and powered descent.

touchdown.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
touchdown.text: Touchdown confirmed. Welcome to Meridian, Jin. Your orbital qualification is complete. On sol twelve, an approaching dust storm will test the outpost's power and oxygen systems. Your next mission begins on the surface.
